lee_design: Quick review: new idea to allow overlaying p99 on the p95 line with a semi-transparent heatmap behind it. Wanted feedback on defaults + accessibility. lee_design: Problem: when we overlay too many layers the chart becomes noisy and users miss the p95 trend. Also some customers asked for p99 context without adding another chart. ashley_eng: Implementation check: overlays add extra series and increase query cost. We should make overlay opt-in and lazy-load p99 series on first toggle. priya_pm: Product note: default off for overlays, but add a single-click 'compare percentiles' quick action that toggles p99. We can track adoption before promoting it. maria_g: Accessibility: heatmap color + opacity must meet contrast with gridlines and axis labels. For colorblind safety propose Okabe-Ito palette for markers and a perceptually-uniform sequential ramp (e.g., viridis) for density. Avoid pure red/green ramps. samir: UX nit: legend ordering should read left-to-right top-to-bottom; when p99 is enabled it should appear after p95 in the legend and be visually distinct (dashed stroke + 60% opacity). Also add `aria-live` region for percentile toggles so screen readers announce changes. lee_design: Love that. For the heatmap layer default opacity 0.25, max 0.6, and an accessibility toggle to increase contrast for high-contrast mode. ashley_eng: We'll lazy-load p99 and heatmap tiles. Suggest storing per-user pref for overlay visibility in `userPrefs` API (not localStorage) so it's consistent across devices. priya_pm: Analytics: event `latency.percentile.toggle` with props {panel_id, percentile, enabled, source}. Also `latency.overlay.palette` when users change palette. maria_g: Microcopy: change tooltip line from "p95: 120ms" to "95th percentile latency: 120 ms" (spacing and SR-friendly). Also tooltips should include sampling method: "Computed from 10% sample" if sampling is active. lee_design: Draft ARIA + legend pattern suggestion: ```
  • ● 95th percentile
``` ashley_eng: I'll wire the `aria-pressed` state and add automated e2e to assert screen reader text changes. Also will implement palette selector with three presets: Default (viridis), High contrast, Colorblind-safe (Okabe-Ito). samir: Mobile layout: stack legend under the chart and collapse the palette selector into a compact dropdown. Keep the compare-percentiles button pinned to the top bar. lee_design: Decision summary: default overlays off, quick action to enable p99, heatmap opacity default 0.25, palettes: viridis / okabe-ito / high-contrast, per-user pref via userPrefs, aria patterns as above, analytics events, and mobile stacking rules. uxbot: Created task INFR-3582 and linked comp: https://figma.com/file/overlay-heatmap-ux?node-id=88 lee_design: Thanks everyone. Action items: Lee update comps and tooltip copy; Ashley implement lazy-load + userPrefs + tests; Priya add events + rollout plan; Maria verify palettes + contrast; Samir mock mobile stack. Sync Friday 10am. :thumbsup:
